instruction.text: Evelyn and Mehmet are preparing a presentation on the dos and don’ts of social media. Fill in the gaps to complete the points that they want to talk about.
instruction.sound: Evelyn and Mehmet are preparing a presentation on the do’s and don’ts of social media. Fill in the gaps to complete the points that they want to talk about.

atoms.b: • As a rule, you should always be ((++friendly mean)) and ((++considerate unfair)) to other people.
• When you’re chatting with unfamiliar people, you should always be careful and ((++not always)) believe everything.
• When you want to post pictures online, you should always ask ((++your_parents no_one)) first.

instruction.text: Evelyn and Mehmet also want to discuss how you should behave in an online chat. Decide what is okay and what is not okay when chatting with people online.

atoms.a: introducing myself with my real name
telling people about my favourite subject in school
telling the people I’m chatting with that they are stupid
sending pictures of myself to everyone
helping others when they have questions
giving out my password when someone asks for it
telling people my exact home address
